maya.activity: Wake up, stretch in bed, read the news on my phone, and quietly check Daniel's face and ask how he is feeling before getting dressed.
maya.intention: Start the morning gently and notice whether Daniel needs immediate help.

maya.activity: Make coffee and a quick breakfast, pack lunch, fill my water bottle, and prepare a thermos of ginger tea for Daniel.
maya.intention: Keep my morning routine while making something practical for Daniel.

maya.activity: Carry the ginger tea to Daniel, check in softly, then put on my work shoes and gather my work items from the entry console.
maya.intention: Make sure Daniel is settled before I leave and avoid rushing him into decisions.

maya.activity: Commute to the transportation department with my packed lunch and work materials.
maya.intention: Get to work on time while staying reachable if Daniel needs me.

maya.activity: Work at the transportation department, review Friday project items, and respond to messages while keeping an eye on my phone for updates from Daniel.
maya.intention: Complete the workday without losing track of Daniel's condition.

maya.activity: Eat my packed lunch and send Daniel a brief, low-pressure message asking whether he needs anything brought home.
maya.intention: Take a real break and check in without making him manage a long conversation.

maya.activity: Continue work at the transportation department, finish the day's tasks, and make a short plan for a simple dinner before leaving.
maya.intention: Close out work cleanly so I can be present at home.

maya.activity: Commute home and stop for anything needed for a simple meal if necessary.
maya.intention: Get home promptly and keep the evening manageable.

maya.activity: Change clothes, put my work items away, make fresh ginger tea, and carry it to Daniel on the sectional with the living-room lights lowered.
maya.intention: Care for Daniel in a quiet, comfortable way and watch for signs that he is worsening.

maya.activity: Sit nearby with my phone available, ask only simple questions, and bring Daniel water or tissues if he needs them.
maya.intention: Be attentive without crowding him while he rests.

maya.activity: Make a simple soup and toast, carry a bowl and spoon to the place Daniel is resting, and eat a small portion myself nearby if he is willing to try some.
maya.intention: Offer an easy meal without pressuring Daniel, and avoid an elaborate dinner.

maya.activity: Clear the dishes, wash the saucepan and bowls, then return to the living room with water and check Daniel's temperature or symptoms if he agrees.
maya.intention: Keep the shared spaces calm and monitor whether home care is enough.

maya.activity: Dim the living room further, sit quietly with a book, and help Daniel settle without expecting conversation.
maya.intention: Give him restful company and let the evening become quieter.

maya.activity: Put away the remaining kitchen things, check that Daniel has water and his phone, and make a short note of any symptoms or medication timing.
maya.intention: Leave the night organized enough that neither of us has to think hard later.

maya.activity: Wash up, change into sleepwear, put my phone on charge, and prepare the bed while leaving reading glasses in the upper nightstand drawer.
maya.intention: Get ready for sleep while staying close enough to help Daniel during the night.

maya.activity: Get into bed, keep water within reach, and settle quietly beside Daniel.
maya.intention: End the day rested enough to respond if Daniel needs care overnight.

daniel.activity: Wake up, shower, make coffee, and listen to a podcast while noticing how Maya is doing. I bring my mug from the kitchen to the bathroom area while getting ready, then carry it back and leave it on the kitchen counter.
daniel.intention: Start the day normally while keeping an eye on Maya and avoiding unnecessary fuss.

daniel.activity: Make a mild breakfast and tea for both of us, then eat at the kitchen counter. I keep a glass of water and a simple portion available for Maya without pressing her to eat, and leave the tasting spoon on the sink side.
daniel.intention: Give Maya something easy to tolerate and make sure I eat before work.

daniel.activity: Set up my work laptop in bedroom 2, connect the laptop cable, put the laptop on its stand, and write a short priority list including checking on Maya during breaks.
daniel.intention: Reorganize the workday around her illness before starting calls.

daniel.activity: Edit dialogue, attend remote production calls, and monitor audio with headphones. Between tasks I quietly check whether Maya needs water or anything brought upstairs, without interrupting her rest unless necessary.
daniel.intention: Complete the morning audio work while remaining available at home.

daniel.activity: Make a quick lunch and a small saucepan of plain broth, carrying the saucepan and a bowl to the kitchen counter. I eat standing at the counter, put a tasting spoon on the sink side, and take a portion to Maya if she wants it.
daniel.intention: Keep both of us fed with something simple and gentle.

daniel.activity: Clear the most visible lunch items, refill my water bottle, and check Maya’s temperature and symptoms without making the situation feel dramatic.
daniel.intention: Reset the kitchen and make a calm assessment before returning to work.

daniel.activity: Continue dialogue editing and remote studio work from bedroom 2, keeping revision notes in writing. I take brief breaks to bring tea or water to Maya and to check whether she needs medicine or rest adjusted.
daniel.intention: Maintain the workday from home rather than leave Maya alone while she feels poorly.

daniel.activity: Stop work, close the laptop, and make a simple evening meal with extra broth. I carry the food and water to the dining table, then bring anything Maya cannot manage to her resting place.
daniel.intention: Replace the usual studio commute with practical care and an easy dinner.

daniel.activity: Eat a small dinner at the dining table and check in with Maya between mouthfuls. I clear the most visible dishes afterward, leaving anything nonurgent for tomorrow.
daniel.intention: Have a proper meal while keeping the evening low-pressure.

daniel.activity: Return to the living room, dim the room, and do a short low-volume piano session with headphones only if Maya is settled. Otherwise I sit on the sectional, drink water, and review tomorrow’s notes quietly.
daniel.intention: Wind down without disturbing Maya or turning her illness into a major event.

daniel.activity: Make tea, prepare a small snack if Maya wants one, and check symptoms once more. I put the mug down on the bar cart while carrying water and supplies, then leave the phone there as usual.
daniel.intention: Be available for the night while keeping the routine calm and ordinary.

daniel.activity: Wash up, brush my teeth, change into sleepwear, and bring a glass of water into bedroom 1. I make sure Maya has what she needs nearby before getting into bed.
daniel.intention: Prepare for sleep while staying ready to help if she wakes.

daniel.activity: Get into the king bed, keep the room quiet, and try to sleep while listening for Maya without repeatedly waking her.
daniel.intention: End the day rested enough to continue helping tomorrow.
